verdict.rationale: Gram supports curated 'toolsets' and versioned Skills that agents 'load on demand' rather than exposing every tool at once, which is directionally aligned with reducing context bloat, but there is no explicit documentation of a runtime meta-tool (e.g., a search_tools/load_tool call) that lets an agent dynamically query and pull individual tool definitions into context on demand. missing for 10: explicit runtime tool-search/meta-tool mechanism, evidence of dynamic per-call tool loading, independent confirmation of reduced context footprint vs static toolset installation.
